1st Party:

The vehicle owner (policyholder) who purchases the insurance.

This person is responsible for paying the insurance premium.


2nd Party:

The insurance company that provides the insurance coverage.

It compensates for damages based on the policy's terms.


3rd Party:

Any other person or property that is affected due to an accident involving the insured vehicle.

This includes pedestrians, passengers (other than the owner), other vehicle owners, or damaged property.
